sub_questions.q: What is the name of the proposed approach evaluated in the paper?
sub_questions.answer: The proposed approach is the Insertion-Deletion Transformer.
sub_questions.quote: We propose the Insertion-Deletion Transformer, a novel transformer-based neural architecture and training method for sequence generation.

sub_questions.q: What is the insertion-only method used as the comparison baseline in the paper?
sub_questions.answer: The insertion-only baseline is the Insertion Model (KERMIT), extending the Insertion Transformer insertion-only framework.
sub_questions.quote: We extend the Insertion Transformer Stern et al. 2019, an insertion-only framework to handle both insertions and deletions.

sub_questions.q: What BLEU scores are reported for the Insertion-Deletion Transformer and the insertion-only baseline on the alphabetic sequence shifting task, and what difference is computed?
sub_questions.answer: On alphabetic sequence shifting, the Insertion-Deletion Model scores 91.49 BLEU and the Insertion Model (KERMIT) scores 70.15 BLEU, giving a difference of 21.34 BLEU points in favor of the Insertion-Deletion Model.
sub_questions.quote: Alphabetic Sequence Shifting BLEU Insertion Model (KERMIT) 70.15 Insertion Deletion Model 91.49

sub_questions.q: What BLEU scores are reported for the Insertion-Deletion Transformer and the insertion-only baseline on the Caesar's cipher task, and what difference is computed?
sub_questions.answer: On Caesar's cipher, the Insertion-Deletion Model scores 37.57 BLEU and the Insertion Model (KERMIT) scores 35.55 BLEU, giving a difference of 2.02 BLEU points; the paper describes this as around 2 BLEU points.
sub_questions.quote: Caesar’s Cipher BLEU Insertion Model (KERMIT) 35.55 Insertion Deletion Model 37.57

sub_questions.q: Does the paper report one overall BLEU difference between the Insertion-Deletion Transformer and the insertion-only method, or separate differences per task?
sub_questions.answer: The paper reports separate BLEU results for two synthetic translation tasks rather than one overall BLEU difference.
sub_questions.quote: We demonstrate the capabilities of our Insertion-Deletion model through experiments on synthetic translation datasets. We show how the addition of deletion improves BLEU score
